prompts.title: TEAR OPEN
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a HIGH-FIDELITY, extremely art-directed website concept presentation board for Diet Code, an independent creative engineering studio. The user likes bold neobrutalist and printed-halftone photographic paper cutouts but demands a more distinctive, less generic composition. Every UI must look deliberately designed, sharp and readable, ready for a sophisticated creative studio. This is a NEW CONCEPT, not an edit of the reference garments.

FACTS AND CONTENT RULES:
Brand: "Diet Code" ONLY, never Diet Codebase.
Studio descriptor: "Independent creative engineering studio." Body: "We design and build digital products."
The ONLY real project is "OOTD", an iOS wardrobe app in development. Project summary: "A wardrobe app for planning looks from what you own." Project action: "View OOTD ↗". NO other named projects, client logos, quotes, awards, metrics, launch claims, downloads, audio work, DSP work, sound engineering, waveforms or fictional capability demonstrations.
Navigation only "Work" "Studio" "Contact"; primary action "Start a project ↗". No invented team roles or geographic locations.
INPUT REFERENCE IMAGES: the 3 attached images are supporting OOTD project imagery ONLY: olive chore jacket, cream tee, straight jeans from the actual app's bundled seed assets. Preserve their recognisable colour, garment style and photographic character in the OOTD section. They are NOT references for the site's page composition. Do not introduce extra products or any clothing brand logos.
If showing an OOTD phone UI, use an illustrative preview informed by the real source: nearly black canvas, charcoal cards, white/gray text, header "Wardrobe", a garment search field, two-column photo grid with Olive Chore Jacket / Cream Tee / Straight Jeans, plus a bottom tab bar "Today" "Wardrobe" "Looks". Do not show made-up AI chat results, tracking metrics or weather forecasts. Place a tiny plain note in the OUTER PRESENTATION BOARD margin only: "OOTD interface preview based on source." It must not be baked into the website UI.

BOTTLE: original smooth green glass soda bottle as a PHOTOGRAPH printed in coarse 45-degree emerald/black halftone and hand-cut from cream paper; natural glass reflections, condensation, visible clear neck and liquid air gap. Vintage italic green "diet code" label with wave underline. Irregular paper edge, subtle hard paper shadow. Not a 3D render, voxel object, flat illustration or plastic toy. The bottle is a studio mascot, not a product for sale. All entire bottles must be fully framed unless a specific macro crop is explicitly requested. No bottle behind important copy.
COMPOSITION QUALITY: real graphic-design hierarchy, sophisticated typography, intentional negative space, distinctive coherent grid, tactile print used selectively, flat colour and single hard rules. No generic rounded cards, gradient blobs, fake windows, floating pills, starbursts, eyes, random stickers, cartoon hands, smileys or scrapbook debris. No rainbow decoration or visual filler.

PRESENTATION FORMAT: large landscape board approximately 2400x1700, neutral light gray outer mount with a small clear direction title. At top: one large complete desktop homepage hero in 1440:900 proportions using 76% of board width; to the right a complete mobile homepage hero in 390:844 proportions using 20%. Flat screenshots with no device frames or perspective around these two. Below, the remaining row shows three miniature full subsequent section screenshots under "PAGE FLOW": OOTD case study, the studio, project enquiry; plus a small three-frame stop-motion storyboard under "MOTION IDEA" on the right. Show actual different layouts, not boxes bearing labels. Readable words in big hero, smaller body not excessive. All key text and actions inside their viewport, no accidental crop, overlap, fake award badges or grid of made-up portfolio projects. Motion storyboard is a proposed design only, no FPS/performance promises.


DIRECTION A / TEAR OPEN. This must be a premium experimental paper-rip composition, dynamic but exceptionally clear.
DESKTOP HERO: upper 40% warm cream paper with an enormous black ultra-wide heavy grotesque "DIET CODE" masthead spanning the width; restrained header nav above the masthead. Below it the paper RIPS into a vivid vermilion red lower field along a single dramatic diagonal ragged edge from high at left to low at right. A huge nearly HORIZONTAL photographic green halftone bottle, cap pointing upper right and base lower left, lies along this seam, about 70% of viewport width and only a 12-degree pitch; this horizontal orientation is essential, do not reuse an upright bottle-right layout. Entire bottle in frame with cream cut edge. It sits predominantly on the RED field, not obscuring the brand. Small cream torn tag near the bottom left reads "Independent creative engineering studio." and a short exact sentence "We design and build digital products."; one black rectangular action at bottom right "View OOTD ↗". Nav is small black type on cream "Work / Studio / Contact" and small black primary action "Start a project ↗". One tiny quiet "Pull to open ↓" cue at the lower ripped edge. The red field has no other decorations.
MOBILE: cream masthead stacked DIET / CODE, red paper rip below, the same bottle steeply diagonal to fit the narrow screen but fully visible, readable studio descriptor, wide black "View OOTD ↗" action inside viewport.
PAGE FLOW: the torn red cover opens to a cream OOTD feature with huge OOTD title and the source-based black wardrobe app UI plus reference garments, visibly label "iOS wardrobe app / In development". Follow with an extremely typographic black "The studio" spread, then red project enquiry close. No other project work.
MOTION IDEA: 3 frames show the cream seam opening, bottle moving a short distance, OOTD case study revealed. Literal stop-motion paper replacement, not particle spectacle.
Mood: a tactile editorial cover being opened. Bottle Theatre's impact, substantially more original page composition.
